scope: RefLog modeless native Find singleton, F3/F5 window dispatch, selected-row search cursor and wrap/case/no-match behavior. Partial parity; full port remains incomplete.

verification.native: Final receiver passed system Git and Git 2.37.1, 2.39.5 and bundled 2.55.0. Actual hidden non-sheet RefLog/Find windows, singleton reuse and retained query, Find close/reopen defaults, owner release and exactly one child close callback on parent close. Direct constructed key-handler inputs exercise F3/F5 and busy/unknown-key guards; events are never sent to an app. Real selected-row/repeated/wrapped/case/ref/action/hash searches, query edit clearing wrap status, no-match selection retention, refresh cursor reset and chooser-mode search passed. HEAD/index/config/worktree are byte-exact unchanged. No visible UI or physical input acceptance is claimed.
verification.regression: Push source-picker receiver passed all four Git versions against final sources: real Log/HEAD RefLog acceptance, cancellation retention, immutable hashes and explicit older-commit Push retained.
verification.iterations: Initial Debug passed; NOTICE then included and Debug rebuilt. First receiver failed an immediate weak-controller-deallocation assertion after parent close. Replaced that assumption with actual owner release, exactly one close callback and closed-window checks; all four Git versions passed without a production cleanup change. Review then added wrap-status clearing on search-text/case edits; final Debug, both native matrices, Store and both audits repeated. Initial failure and earlier passing logs retained.
verification.builds: Final unsigned Debug and AppStore builds, both bundle audits and exact bundled NOTICE comparisons passed. All 96 upstream icons verified. Store --require-git audited 11 universal Git Mach-O files and real Git fixtures. EditorConfig/IssueRegex audits passed.
verification.core: No Core source change and no new Core suite run in this checkpoint; native receiver uses real Git fixtures and the existing Core RefLog reader.
verification.documentation: RefLog parity, pinned source inventory and NOTICE updated. Inventory pin and seven-column CSV validation passed. Local documentation site generated, unpublished.
verification.ci: Native receiver added to macOS workflow. Hosted CI/push remain unverified; authentication unavailable, no retry.
verification.processes: All compiler/native/audit sessions terminal. No main app launched; receiver windows remain hidden and owned windows close. Final app/native receiver process audit empty. Twelve empty owned PushSourcePickers UUID preference files removed across current/prior flushes and regression iterations; unrelated/nonempty files retained.
verification.limitations: Physical F3/F5/Command-F routing, Find focus and owner visibility/minimization, scroll-to-match, rendered light/dark layout, broader Unicode matching and signed sandbox execution remain pending. Reflog action/message are searched; commit-message bodies are not loaded by the current reader. Full revision menus, non-stash deletion, sorting/columns/geometry, Finder activation, complete dialog parity, updated genuine screenshots/manual, hosted publication and signed App Store distribution remain incomplete.
